text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pardon me… It's just that I've had a headache for a little while. I don't think it's anything to—

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Attention, all units. Did you hear that? Escort Her Highness to the nearest medical facility at once!

text_block_list.name: Security Officer
text_block_list.text: Captain! Transport preparations are complete! We've also booked Her Highness in for a complete medical evaluation!

text_block_list.name: Voice on the Radio
text_block_list.text: This is Eagle Squad. Now dispatching chopper to school rooftop. ETA is in two minutes. Over.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Copy. Everyone, take your positions! Operation Doctor's Visit is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahem! By the power vested in my name, I hereby order you to abort this operation at once!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We must not cause an undue ruckus at the academy. I have no need for medical treatment at this time.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Understood, Your Highness! My apologies. All units, stand down! Return to default positions!
choice_data_list: L-let's just see how you feel in a bit.
L-let's just see how you feel in a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ooouch… All that shouting has got my head pounding again…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's migraine doesn't go away, however, and she struggles with the pain for a while.
